categories_thin: Architecture - only four Monroe-based architects/firms surfaced, three of them home-office sole practitioners. Larger firms serving the township are in Princeton, East Brunswick, Freehold or Cranbury and are outside the zone.
Land surveying - two firms only. Surveying is a small field with mostly one-person practices that have little web presence.
Environmental consulting - three firms, two of them at the same Abeel Rd industrial address. Most Phase I/remediation work for Monroe is done by firms based in Cranbury, East Windsor and Princeton.
Staffing - four local offices plus excluded national branches. The Monroe/Jamesburg border along Forsgate Dr holds most of them, so municipal assignment of a few is ambiguous.
Title - one active agency found. The rest of the local closing work is handled by agencies in East Brunswick, Jamesburg and Freehold.

Independent wealth management - nearly all Monroe offices found are bank or national-brand branches (Merrill, J.P. Morgan, PNC, Edward Jones, Santander, Steward Partners), which the brief excludes or flags; genuinely independent RIAs headquartered in town appear to be only a handful.
Consulting - many results were directory-only or single-source entries; the township has little dedicated consulting office stock outside the Forsgate/Centre Dr buildings.
caveats: Zone clipping: Monroe Township, Middlesex County runs roughly 10 miles north-south. Central and northern Monroe (Prospect Plains Rd, Applegarth Rd, Forsgate Dr, Centre Dr, Spotswood-Englishtown Rd, Route 33 near the municipal building, Perrineville Rd/Concordia) is inside a 10-mile radius of Milltown center. The southern tier near Englishtown/Millstone and the far south along Cranbury-South River Rd is at or beyond 10 miles and should be treated as outside; entries whose address could not be geolocated were kept and flagged.

Jamesburg Borough is a separate municipality inside the 10-mile circle; its businesses (e.g. accountants on Buckelew Ave, elder-law attorneys on E Railroad Ave) were excluded. A few entries on the Monroe/Jamesburg line (Marlow Agency on E Railroad Ave, New Wave People and Bryant Staffing at 241 Forsgate Dr) are flagged for municipal confirmation.

Branded franchise and chain locations were excluded per the brief but are recorded here so nothing is lost: State Farm agents Shilpa Rathi (211 Applegarth Rd, Ste 105) and Gary Hughes (157 Prospect Plains Rd); Allstate agents Raina Rauf / Vijay Deshpande (350 Applegarth Rd); ERA Central Realty Group / ERA Central Levinson (349 Applegarth Rd) and ERA Absolute Realty (369 Applegarth Rd); Century 21 About Town Realty (315 Forsgate Dr) and Century 21 Action Plus Realty (1600 Perrineville Rd); RE/MAX Platinum Realty (350 Forsgate Dr) and RE/MAX First Realty (347 Schoolhouse Rd); Realty Executives (1 Rossmoor Dr); Weichert (Monroe office, address unconfirmed); Merrill and J.P. Morgan and PNC Wealth Management and TD Wealth and Edward Jones and Santander offices; Adecco Staffing (101 Middlesex Center Blvd); ADP (259 Prospect Plains Rd).

Yellow Pages, BBB, Superpages, Cylex, Justia, Avvo, Manta and the Overpass/OSM API all blocked automated access from this environment; their content was used only as returned by search results, so some addresses and phone numbers are second-hand and should be re-verified before outreach.

Martindale's 'Monroe Township' attorney index mixes in lawyers whose offices are in New Brunswick, East Brunswick, Freehold, Cranbury and Philadelphia; only entries with a Monroe address or a Monroe-specific firm page were kept.

Several entries are home-based professional practices (Polonia Ct, Spruce St, Villa Farms Circle, Morning Glory Dr, Julia Dr, Katherine St, Jillian Ct, Tany Ct, Violet Ct, Timber Hill Dr, Old Forge Rd, MacFarlane Cir). They are legitimate independent businesses and are included, but they have no storefront and often no website.

Two Monroe addresses recur for the same firm in different sources (New Jersey Realty: 174 Prospect Plains Rd vs 439 Schoolhouse Rd; Strich Law: Monroe Route 33 vs a Cranbury header on its site). Both variants are noted in the entries.
data_gaps: Google Maps rendered only a limited five-result view per query in this browser, so map-based enumeration of every category is incomplete.
No municipal business-registration or licensed-business list could be obtained; monroetwp.com's 'Local Businesses' page and its business pages did not render.
Overpass/OSM was unreachable, so there is no independent structural cross-check of the directory lists.

Many directory-only entries lack a confirmed website or phone (Magnum Investigations, Kalian Corp, Corporate Office Properties, Compucon, Bureau of Dangerous Goods, Brandesign, Vertis, Abacus Insurance, Hein Insurance, Monet Home Sales, Island Appraisal, The Awerbuch Group address).

Coverage is thinnest for micro-businesses that directories miss: solo consultants, bookkeepers, notaries, home-based designers and IT contractors. Further sweeps of the Forsgate Dr, Centre Dr and Route 33 office suites would likely add names.
